subject: Application for the Android HMI Architect role
paragraphs: For twelve years I have designed in-car user interfaces, most recently the architecture of a three-display infotainment system that now ships in four model lines.

In my current team I introduced the split between vehicle services and the interface, halved the application's start time and built a test bench where every change runs on real hardware before it is merged.
Your posting describes exactly this work: one platform carrying several brands, and a team that wants to ship fast and safely. I would be glad to show you in a conversation how I go about it.
